To add a collider, there is 6 values. 1 and 2 is the top left x and y, 3 and 4 is the length and width of the collider, and number 5 is the type(Ignore 6). 1, 2, 3 and 4 should be multiples of 10.

Please set the theme to any of these:
Overworld
Underground
Forest
Airship
Snow
Desert

I will probably add more types in the future, but for now you can use these

Mushrooms and Fire Flowers can only appear out of QMarkMushroom blocks. If wanted, I can fix this if needed in your levels.

Types(These are tile and entity data. CASE SENSITIVE):
Blank(Like #2) - Ground
Sign#
GreenKoopa#
Goomba#
Buzzy#
Bill#
DryBones#
MovingMushroom#
Moving1up#
FireFlower#(No gravity. Base powerup for themes, but has the same name)
Block
QMark
QMarkMushroom
Brick
Pipe
Semisolid
Coin#
Statue#
Statue2#(V3 should be 30)
Flagpole(V4 should be 90, Don't let them be collided from the back)
